verdict.rationale: Spline's docs cover reusable Components (spline-docs-5) and a 'variables-and-data' section for interactivity (real-time API, webhooks), but there is no evidence of design tokens for color/spacing/typography or theme/mode switching applied across designs — a core design-system feature seen in tools like Figma. Missing for 10: any documentation of color/spacing/typography tokens, theme or mode support, or cross-file token application.
